cards.card_text: Paul says the Spirit Himself intercedes for us.
cards.verse_text: For we do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.
cards.snippet: …do not know how we ought to pray, but the Spirit Himself intercedes for us with groans too deep for words.

cards.card_text: When we don't know how we ought to pray, how does Paul say the Spirit intercedes for us?

cards.card_text: Paul says the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
cards.verse_text: And He who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for the saints according to the will of God.
